result.summary: The page renders cleanly with no obvious broken layout, overlapping, or missing images. The only findings are minor low-contrast text, which is a readability concern rather than a visual break. The clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom are intentional scroll affordances and were not counted as defects.

issues.description: Some secondary text is light gray on a white or light gray background, including the search placeholder, the delivery fee labels, and the '(500+)' review count. Contrast may fall below WCAG AA recommendations.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary gray text (for example to at least #6B6B6B on white) so it meets a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
